name: WordoBot Marketing Manager
author: wordobot

sections.description:
WordoBot Marketing Manager allows users to generate marketing content and featured images directly from the WordPress admin panel using the WordoBot API.

The plugin streamlines content creation by combining listing details, reusable customer insights, and automated generation workflows.

Features include:

  • Fetch listing details from a URL, existing posts, or manual input
  • Create and manage structured customer insights (fears, pain points, problems, needs, desires, aspirations)
  • Generate marketing content drafts based on insights and selected styles
  • Track content and image generation status via a history dashboard
  • Retry failed content or image generation tasks
  • Generate featured images using AI
  • Connect securely via OAuth and manage account usage and profile settings

External services used by this plugin are documented below.

Users must authenticate via OAuth to use these features.

External Services

This plugin connects to the WordoBot API to authenticate users and generate marketing content and AI images.

Data sent may include:
– Listing details
– Customer insights
– Content generation parameters
– Authentication information required for account connection and token refresh

Data is sent only when:
– The user connects their WordoBot account through OAuth
– The user requests content generation
– The user requests image generation
– Authentication tokens are refreshed

This data is used only to provide the requested WordoBot services.

Service provider: WordoBot

Privacy policy:
https://wordobot.com/privacy-policy/

Terms of service:
https://wordobot.com/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wordobot-marketing-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WordoBot Marketing → Settings & Profile.
  4. Click Reconnect to WordoBot and sign in to connect your account.
  5. Configure default category settings.
  6. Start generating content from the Content Generation section.
sections.faq:
Why is content status still pending?

WordoBot jobs are processed asynchronously. WordPress cron polling updates statuses periodically.

Can I retry failed jobs?

Yes. Use the Retry option in the Content History section for failed content or image jobs.

Where are listing details and insights stored?

Data is stored in post meta (wordobot_listing_data, wordobot_customer_insights, wordobot_listing_url) for reuse.
